source.text: Good morning, everyone. @Huilan Chen, thank you for your hard work, waiting for your final draft. Also, regarding the API gateway selection, based on yesterday's analysis, I further confirmed APISIX's advantages in dynamic configuration and plugin ecosystem. My main task today is to design specific routing strategies based on APISIX, especially the routing rules and authentication logic for core microservices such as users, consultations, and medical records.

source.text: Progress update on the medication plan check-in module: Yesterday, I almost finished writing the logic for switching between different check-in and make-up check-in states. Today's focus is on jointly debugging the backend check-in interface. I looked at the interface documentation written by @Junxin Yuan last week, and the returned data structure is very clear, so the integration should go smoothly.
